metadata.title: 第三章文献指导抽象仿真数值输入包
metadata.source_document: research/第三章实验输入来源核查与配置草案.md
metadata.rational_encoding: Physical and time scalars are decimal or rational strings; counts and seeds are integers. Derived values use exact numerator/denominator strings, or integer strings when denominator=1.

literature_methods.scenario_shared_deployment: P1 Kim §3.1, §5; concrete scenario and Stage catalog values are self-set
literature_methods.legal_support: P2 HaX-CoNN §3; support in this package is self-set
literature_methods.response: P3 Da Costa §3.3 Eq.(5), §5.4; reference durations and alpha are self-set
literature_methods.activity_power: P1 §5.2.3, P7 §5 Eq.(9)-(16); V^2 f generation uses self-set reference power and OPPs
literature_methods.thermal: P5 F-DTM §IV-A2 Eq.(2)-(5), P6 Chantem §II-B Eq.(2)-(5); all C, G and leakage values are self-set
literature_methods.workload_construction: P4 Zhou §6.1; the finite workloads, service conditions and budgets are self-set

limitations: No safe schedule, optimum, solver execution or performance conclusion is supplied
The 400 ms window and 5 ms start grid remain declared abstract input choices
No old 0.25 ms duration or 0.0625 mJ energy-lattice assumption applies

execution_rules.shared_deployment_scope: same application Stage across all scenarios and request copies
execution_rules.scenario_entry: independent; no inherited unfinished work or preceding-scenario temperature

platform.temperature_slope_applies_to: each local node, both working and idle; CPU baseline is charged once per group

defaults.deadline_reference: scaled highest-frequency CPU chain length; independent of response variant

comparison_rules.energy_objective: sum of scenario probability times full-window system energy in J
comparison_rules.normalized_energy_denominator: safe HEFT energy of the same problem; absent if HEFT has no safe output
comparison_rules.sa_summary: per-instance success count/5 and median/range of safe energies; never best-of-five as equal-budget comparison
comparison_rules.main_paired_energy_subset: problems where MILP, HEFT and all five SA runs succeed
